record.title: Al-Wadea brief passenger interruption, 8 November 2017
record.scope: Yemen land crossings; operational reopening evidence at al Wadea
record.crossings: Yemen land crossings; operational reopening evidence at al Wadea
record.enforcement: Local November7 official claim of passenger/goods movement contradicts uniform implementation from November6. Reuters describes observed supplies crossing November9.
record.status_observation: Historical sources checked 22 October 2026; no current status inference.
record.official_rationale: Reason for the specific 8 November al-Wadea interruption is not established.
record.context: It occurred after the broader coalition blockade announcement, but reporting says al-Wadea continued operating after that announcement. The linkage is contextual, not a verified cause.
record.uncertainty: Coalition general order announced November6. November7 local official denies closure for travellers and goods; November8 local reports describe hours-long closure and announced restoration; Reuters witnesses report supplies crossing November9; ACAPS synthesis says November13. No single matched operational interval established.

historical.duration_note: Withdrawn: formal general order is not a proven Wadea operational onset; contradictory reopening dates and November7 movement defeat a continuous November6–9 interval.
